outages.description: A network fault caused a near-total loss of Internet traffic from Claro Dominicana (AS6400), affecting fixed and mobile services.
A power plant failure at WEB Aruba caused a significant drop in Internet traffic from SETAR (AS11816), Aruba's main telecom provider.
Damage to energy facilities cut power in Zhytomyr and disrupted Internet connectivity
A failure on Peru's national power grid cut electricity across northern Peru on November 1, impacting Internet traffic in Piura starting around 19:45 UTC (14:45 local).
A reported drone strike on the Luhansk Telephone Company building caused a complete outage of Internet traffic from LTC (AS29031).
